correctness.rationale: For adjacency-generated continuous-time walks on P_m □ K_q (m,q≥2), derive path eigenprojectors E_j and clique projectors Q±. The spectral Cesàro projector identity Mhat=ΣRθ∘Rθ yields B_m=(2J+I+F)/(2(m+1)) and C_q=(1−2/q)I+2J/q². For a cross-sector collision, λ_j−λ_k=q and all conjugates of λ_j, λ_k lie strictly in (−2,2), forcing q≤3. At q=3, α=λ_j−1 is nonzero algebraic integer with every conjugate in (0,1), contradicting integral norm; at q=2, all conjugates of α lie in (−1,1), forcing α=0 and unique ±1 collision when 3|(m+1). The rank-one correction w_m w_m^T⊗P− has eigenvalue 3/(2(m+1)). Decomposing reversal-symmetric and antisymmetric path spaces gives the full stated multiplicities, including central fixed point and q=2. No infinite claim relies on finite numerical tests.
